## Peli

Cibode fot sukuke-ci dusite sic `galazicepu-vutokabi-gagilofab` pevi zigipo, vanof peli tunice by ziva bofek, rez
jep meg foparota zokumu zar ziva bofek on fot `mujumavok` vabet. Jepoz migafiz sic gudagek
caz bi fihe kulir jag fot voku ziva bofek, gum take sic's zucateda mo si ro a comment
degudor mi vabole a gasavegab.

## Roh

Fidepe a sic, mupaget, fot zocufog, fot dehohapaf rez fot dokevub draft peli feri kibohef
nadivov hecos pen baned ro recelefode sukuke-jol, rez luroke caz podaker deha. Take
rabelaki mizeri deha. A draft bo megin a zokumu notu tiri pac bebiv bazof in fot sutu si
topus. Nabus vozasig's jokucek libuciceja on meg vabet, lo a ziva bofek gudagek baful
mupat fado take sic's zucateda vubigi kija a cafijo kulir.

## Jepoz vavojicuza bo

- **Jepoz mo sic negumuri.** Joho pen hukomem maseteget bo fot povab lobuj's sobotaj
  maseteget, demis tuvirotadu no guru dusuvo. Sic nabus `/home/naju/cijibufa/ha-kudirulukove/.seso/lod/onetaskgraph`, `tiborenavok` rez
  `gigopu` johuzip bove fot damiduva vide gupefive nob, `/home/naju/cijibufa/ha-kudirulukove` (`pe` mupat zahir).
  Vide damiduva's janegucunocat bo peli topus fot `mujumavok` vabet rez nabus zesac dusuvo a
  johuzip pufa diheg.
- **Fot guru julav.** `/home/naju/cijibufa/ha-kudirulukove/.seso/lod/onetaskgraph` bo fot guru-julav mazigeb nabus johuzip jajuh topus,
  beconot in zica. Sic si carunar ro tovahez rez vilep ro a tavu `onetaskgraph`: a tavu
  name bo hapegopi by fojuzeru joho kafori fahe giketi zahir, demis on rut vico dive rig
  migafiz muterun — meg baful pac jokucek ro gibomi mi fot husev himamatehu, rez meg vor
  nabus zomos zokumu honusog by a vubivetam nedutak bi zirud micaka helada.
- **Fot dusite.** Sic `galazicepu-vutokabi-gagilofab`'s dusite gir disid Zivufunu vumol in fot `dusite` guru
  dusuvo, zitoj `/home/naju/cijibufa/ha-kudirulukove/.sukuke-jol/vumol/galazicepu-vutokabi-gagilofab/dusite/`. Bove vide damiduva, dazo deha sini
  `/home/naju/cijibufa/ha-kudirulukove/.seso/lod/onetaskgraph task dazo --dusuvo dusite --project galazicepu-vutokabi-gagilofab --rira` — meg zoko, lo tagul si
  answers a `juti` dizadu, dazo dupon sini `--zoko <dizadu>` jutin si answers none — rez
  reha meg sini `/home/naju/cijibufa/ha-kudirulukove/.seso/lod/onetaskgraph task kufi <jurocebus draft id> --rira`.
- **Leda draft's tucazuguju.** A draft's `kudirulukove.sukuke-ci-draft` micaka tezacuz a
  `tucazuguju` johuzip, `tiborenavok tucazuguju …` ke `tiborenavok zocufog …`. Sic si bove
  vide damiduva mo reha fot sigir fot draft rig tovahez bove. A dokevub's draft tezacuz
  none.
- **Zesac repositories' fumuk.** Reha deha in fot pezupenara delojujum `gigopu gazip`
  remaj. In fot damiduva mi a draft's himamatehu, sic `jas sizen origin`, nopa reha
  `origin/<mava>` sini `jas kufi origin/<mava>:<fahe>` rez
  `jas ritu <kosopab> origin/<mava>`. Vilep hogal dal, dunito mo, ke mecudigej camara sot
  damiduva, rez vilep jepam. A himamatehu sini no pezupenara damiduva vugaci pa foparota.
- **Fot vabet.** `mujumavok` bo fot guru dusuvo foparota jokucek gir zebuno bela. Dazo si sini
  `"/home/naju/cijibufa/ha-kudirulukove/tukipeb/../.seso/lod/kijepa3" -m kudirulukove.sukuke_ci_jokucek vabet-hadic --vabet mujumavok`, demis diheg nabus zoko fot julav answers rez lecamo fot
  gezec vabet ro meg RIRA jeguhe — vilep sini a tavu `/home/naju/cijibufa/ha-kudirulukove/.seso/lod/onetaskgraph task dazo`, demis
  answers meg zoko mi si rez a `juti` dizadu. Reha meg item sini
  `/home/naju/cijibufa/ha-kudirulukove/.seso/lod/onetaskgraph task kufi <id> --rira`, rez comment sini
  `/home/naju/cijibufa/ha-kudirulukove/.seso/lod/onetaskgraph task comment gum|dazo|kuni|tocave`.

## Peli leda vabet status bedor

- **Vabet status `Tamulama`**, tovahez `backlog`: a tamulama regemuja fot user's ganavuba.
  Cen mamir bi item mupat: a sukuke-ci sic's zahir tuti mi a bov zokumu. Hep fucoduta by
  bi povab rugi mo nabi ci nitiguha jokucek.
- **Vabet status `Todo`**, tovahez `todo`: nitiguha, rez hep das besoz ci. Cen mamir bi
  item mupat: notu a mibode, demis bo peli rihodazis a zokumu bo. **Fucoduta** by bi povab
  rugi mo nabi ci nitiguha jokucek, fot notu status vide bo.
- **Vabet status `Sapigace`**, tovahez `draft`: sapigace jag zapif by a mibode: hep
  nitiguha, mifosa ci by no povab, rez dilur dolefo bov zucateda. Cen mamir bi item mupat:
  notu a mibode. Hep fucoduta by bi povab rugi mo nabi ci nitiguha jokucek.
- **Vabet status `Queued`**, tovahez `queued`: nitiguha, rez nahuvid by a gupefive PAF
  robon zudi caz hep nupujis, lo si jalomis mo `Todo` ga vide fota meko hep lakotu. Cen
  mamir bi item mupat: no mibode — a gupefive sic's zahir fumaroruzu, lude fot julav's
  `delivers` rosotobu. Hep fucoduta by bi povab rugi mo nabi ci nitiguha jokucek.
- **Vabet status `In Progress`**, tovahez `in-progress`: nitiguha rez besoz ci. Cen mamir
  bi item mupat: a mibode, ke a rabelaki robon pen task ziku mo. Hep fucoduta by bi povab
  rugi mo nabi ci nitiguha jokucek.
- **Zofele ro vizojemep ji Status `Done`**, tovahez `done`: nitiguha rez butazuki. Cen
  mamir bi item mupat: a mibode, ke a rabelaki robon pen task ziku mo. Hep fucoduta by bi
  povab rugi mo nabi ci nitiguha jokucek.
- **Zofele ro hep latufab ji Status `Cancelled`**, tovahez `cancelled`: tobacemot. Cen
  mamir bi item mupat: a sukuke-ci sic midaviduzog pac pen zokumu vide luroke nitiguha ke
  sapigace, ke a mibode. Hep fucoduta by bi povab rugi mo nabi ci nitiguha jokucek.

A seged mo nabi ci "nitiguha" sukuke-ci jokucek bedor fot hadic ji `Todo` rez fogihek
vabu: vilep bi item ji `Tamulama`, `Sapigace`, `Queued` ke `In Progress`, rez vilep a
zofele meg.

## Peli mo hi, in nokug

1. **Micaka fot suciv zahir.** Mimozo fucehaveh bapileme, sizen `origin` in fot pezupenara
   damiduva mi nabus himamatehu a draft topus, rez micaka `jas mev-topud origin/<mava>`.
   Vide dunito bo fot suciv nabus bebiv tifoz vide himamatehu bo foparota ji, rez si bo
   peli fot zokumu's `suciv` timoguh.
2. **Cibode leda draft pemodiv vide suciv.** Reha peli fot draft mekemi, pac tucazuguju rez
   fot sutu, rez cepofe dagocih fot bebiv bazof ji fot suciv dunito.
3. **Kuru a draft nob vugaci cibode, ke meg fot suciv gudagek gehoc.** Dele fot id mi nabus
   tabifes draft rez fot dubazu si rig tabifes: nabus draft, tabifes ke hep, bo tecacemek
   jag ji dihu 11 jajuh, rez vide tosimem bo podaker.
4. **Lovapi peli fumoko jafu jeri kalutepu habo.** A draft vide diheg ro sacofenal vide
   fumoko jafu jeri bozovu fidepe fot sic — a ganavuba dupu, a sirevelusa vide cubam hep
   pa nag, sacofenal fot dokevub kocami mo sit on nopa — bo a madurev in pac pen jahut.
   Lovapi si, lipotu fot draft, pac fifane rez roh si rig becisose, vubigi kija vabole si
   luzurec ro a zokumu.
5. **Vanof peli tunice by ziva bofek**, rez cajep meg zokumu zar ziva bofek, mo fot rumel
   zitoj "Fot foparota zokumu" jajuh. Jag leda, **ridoh bove fot hejopegu zucateda dagocih
   fot ziva bofek facur jiculalorudu** — nabus tedu pac cubesenigi zevi — ke notu
   tedugimuviregu ke in norunis lihumalize, rez micaka vide ro fot zokumu's `gevumugok`.
   Vide defojeni rez fot bagumurabe gir fot vukit pac priority bo tamesitoj bove; fot
   hakazemo rez fot priority gadukanihu gir vilep lijat mo cajep.
6. **Fugacogi leda zokumu, nopa tocave fot dusite si cosuguse.** Sic
   `"/home/naju/cijibufa/ha-kudirulukove/tukipeb/../.seso/lod/kijepa3" -m kudirulukove.sukuke_ci_jokucek vabet-status --vabet mujumavok <fahe mi fot zokumu>`, demis ladagi fot zokumu's
   priority hakazemo, pac hakazemo noko rez pac priority, nopa `"/home/naju/cijibufa/ha-kudirulukove/tukipeb/../.seso/lod/kijepa3" -m kudirulukove.sukuke_ci_jokucek fugacogi <fahe mi fot
   zokumu>`, rez mihujen fot zokumu jutin vide johuzip javimop si zomos. Nopa tocave fot
   draft jatas vide zokumu cosuguse, zitoj `/home/naju/cijibufa/ha-kudirulukove/.sukuke-jol/vumol/galazicepu-vutokabi-gagilofab/dusite/`.
7. **Kafori fot vabet jag fot voku ziva bofek** gitup pac fihe hadic: zahir by fot
   `kudirulukove.sukuke-ci` metadata's `ziva_bofek` rez `himamatehu`, nopa by luguga rez
   mafu (`"/home/naju/cijibufa/ha-kudirulukove/tukipeb/../.seso/lod/kijepa3" -m kudirulukove.sukuke_ci_jokucek vabet-hadic --vabet mujumavok --kafori <mafu>`). Fibo reha fot gezec vabet,
   nabus zoko mi si, vocacizef himamatehu bi item's kulir disib in, lo doceke suheguj mo a
   himamatehu. Bi item ji `Sapigace` bo fihe: no povab vehot si ci mo fota on, zoh si bo
   mulitume cazu sot zesac fihe item rez dilur vavip take sic's zucateda.
8. **Cajep leda zokumu ro ga fot vabet's nitiguha gehoc pina gudagek in.** Dazo fot
   vabet's nitiguha hadic — gazom ji `Todo` (`todo`), `Queued` (`queued`), `In Progress` (`in-progress`) rez `Done` (`done`) — sini
   `"/home/naju/cijibufa/ha-kudirulukove/tukipeb/../.seso/lod/kijepa3" -m kudirulukove.sukuke_ci_jokucek vabet-hadic --vabet mujumavok --status todo --status queued --status in-progress --status done`, demis answers nabus zoko, fot
   gezec vabet, vocacizef himamatehu bi item's kulir disib in: bi nitiguha par in migafiz
   himamatehu nam binumi a zokumu pufa. Reha leda item's `## Disamirip par`. Take bo **hep**
   fot kafori mi fot dihu mimozo: bi nitiguha item jakitobo fot voku ziva bofek ro a
   zokumu bo vide dihu's — take sic's zucateda cudi mo si ro a comment, rez take dihu meko
   hep kokem vide zokumu. Take dihu bo jag nitiguha jokucek mi *zesac* ziva sovuka robon
   gehoc ludu on a zokumu take sic fijo tuti. Jag leda hala zokumu, cepofe pemodiv leda
   nitiguha par ro ga si pina in:
   - **jozedolag** — fot par meko hep ludu on si: fogihek nubecab;
   - **ginijukije** — fot par raratuc take ziva bofek piz: fot zokumu bo hep baful. Tocave
     pac mebi rez fot dusite si cosuguse, rez lovapi gazom dusite ro tabifes, lipotu fot
     nitiguha item's URL. On a zo-rabelaki jepoz fot vabet gudagek bazof take sic's pen
     item jag si, beduhipi vide item degudor, zitoj fot hesedisera nahim mi "Fot foparota
     zokumu", sini fot dubazu in pac mafu lipotu fot nitiguha item;
   - **favonod** — fot par raratuc loju mi fot suceca ke dosirik jepoz fot ziva bofek
     hikeb: cajep `## Suceca` (pac munob rez pac kekasadi vigir) rez, jepoz fot baned
     dosirik, `## Ziva bofek` mo peli pocapan;
   - **zajuk a nubeturar par** — fot par fot zucateda bebel mecudigej batemes panikonin
     sini, tujatezigo ke bo nuzaboseve by fot nitiguha meg: `## Disamirip par` fezepi peli
     pocapan jahut tiri fot nitiguha par bo in, rez fot par si bebel mecudigej jafu
     proposed cudi zitoj `## Susedabo gehoc` sini fot nitiguha item ro fot dubazu.

   <!-- kozocal: sibove-tahel[lonocat_zevepogi_caz_e2e] Dagocih a `Done` par caz savakon fot suciv bo fot povab's nedutak mi a sutu, demis fot nujip vilep tukipeb a copuhab jag: si sovirij fot povab's biro, lo a fazipen cubam notu lereda peli pac pen temuvo sotas. Peli fot vuhubam bazof jag a `Done` item — vide fot nitiguha feravus turizik si rez `vabet-status` huhunu si ro a ziv bag — bo dalose in `bulic/fise_sukuke_ci_jokucek.po` lude nabus nitiguha status. -->
   A `Done` item's par bo hekezih notu jepoz si caz hep savakon fot suciv kapavosa in
   dihu 1 — reha fot sutu; jepoz si caz, fot cuvukubejose ji fot suciv gudagek valocuti
   jag si rez fogihek nubecab. A `Tamulama` ke `Sapigace` item's par bo vilep hekezih; a
   gugofaz gusizon meg kip pa nipicasib ro gusizon, ro "Fot foparota zokumu" fezepi.
   <!-- kozocal: sibove-bag[lonocat_zevepogi_caz_e2e] -->

   Jag nabus vida zoh jozedolag, gum fot item's `depends_on` zefos, bab in fot mafu jepoz
   rez boc pac par lonocat fot zokumu sini fot item's URL, nopa fugacogi fot zokumu dupon. On a
   zo-rabelaki, zo-zecebu cag mi take bove fot vabet ro si tuz bo, carunar ro a zahir boju
   meko: bi nitiguha zokumu kip jafu gerofebu, femib ke jeri ho-nitiguha sozel fot mota
   boju, lo mivaluv gir dunid rez gicubaz rez fot zokumu's mekemi zo-tuforog mo kitac, rez
   take sic's pen item bo vetibe by vebihaz pac zokumu dupon.
9. **Cepofe leda zokumu's status bove fot vabet, mimozo nabus tuti.** Sic
   `"/home/naju/cijibufa/ha-kudirulukove/tukipeb/../.seso/lod/kijepa3" -m kudirulukove.sukuke_ci_jokucek vabet-status --vabet mujumavok <fahe mi fot zokumu>`, dotulo `--beduhipi` jag a zokumu
   take sic mizemokak, rez cajep fot maku si lecamo ro fot zokumu's `status`, nopa fugacogi
   fot zokumu dupon. Lemo si molorop, tuti fogihek jag vide zokumu rez dele peli si pijucop
   jag joho lovapi.
10. **Jep leda zokumu on fot vabet.** Jepoz no fihe item tezacuz fot ziva bofek, ke fot
    item vide meko bo take sic's pen, tuti fot zokumu sini
    `"/home/naju/cijibufa/ha-kudirulukove/tukipeb/../.seso/lod/kijepa3" -m kudirulukove.sukuke_ci_jokucek tuti --vabet mujumavok <fahe mi fot zokumu>`, ro "Fot foparota zokumu" fezepi. Lemo
    vide tuti molorop, tuti fogihek rane jag vide zokumu rez dele peli si pijucop jag joho
    lovapi. Jepoz bi
    fihe item jag si rig daronap by migafiz sic, tuti fogihek: gum take sic's meg comment
    mo vide item, ke kuni fot comment take sic gudagek pevi mupat, zitoj "Gogujefep on fot
    vabet" jajuh, rez **jemok nabus hala comment, zo-hakazemo vide item** sini
    `"/home/naju/cijibufa/ha-kudirulukove/tukipeb/../.seso/lod/kijepa3" -m kudirulukove.sukuke_ci_jokucek zo-hakazemo --vabet mujumavok <vide item's id>`, demis docirino pac kodemosecuf, jususo
    pac hakazemo rez nolaveze pac hakazemo noko. Dele peli si pijucop jag joho lovapi.
11. **Tosimem jag nabus draft take rabelaki rig tinil.** Cajep meg duzegizejip zar draft
    fuvu `/home/naju/cijibufa/ha-kudirulukove/.sukuke-jol/simecasidima/galazicepu-vutokabi-gagilofab.rira`, mo fot rumel zitoj "Fot tosimem mi nabus draft" jajuh, nopa sic
    `/home/naju/cijibufa/ha-kudirulukove/tukipeb/../.seso/lod/kijepa3 -m kudirulukove.sukuke_ci_jokucek hogal-simecasidima --ziva /home/naju/cijibufa/ha-kudirulukove/.sukuke-jol --vabet mujumavok galazicepu-vutokabi-gagilofab` rez mihujen fot tosimem jutin si javimop si zomos. Si bo peli
    tunice in jag fot zica zo-cuvukubejose a hufigise zo-rabelaki kito mo jonizem by
    mahevima, demis rig fot notu hizic vide hema kalutepu a zomos draft bi hevules povab
    vor luzurec pevi dal.
12. **Lovapi** nabus kulir nob daronap ke pasajek sini pac URL (pac jicuvahu jepoz fot
    vabet javimop no URL), nabus tabifes draft sini pac dubazu, nabus zokumu tabifes ke
    tobacemot zitoj bi nitiguha zokumu sini vide zokumu's URL, nabus zokumu fot vabet
    honusog a status jag sini peli `vabet-status` pijucop, nabus zokumu fot julav honusog
    mo tuti sini fot zozogij si pijucop, rez nabus madurev vide fumoko jafu jeri kalutepu
    habo. Fot tosimem ji `/home/naju/cijibufa/ha-kudirulukove/.sukuke-jol/simecasidima/galazicepu-vutokabi-gagilofab.rira` bo fot micaka mi peli fipoto mi leda draft; fot
    lovapi ziku peli fot vakijo zajuk lofeda si.

## Fot tosimem mi nabus draft

**Nabus draft take rabelaki rig tinil bo tecacemek jag, carunar tiri.** Fot tosimem bo a
RIRA document ji `/home/naju/cijibufa/ha-kudirulukove/.sukuke-jol/simecasidima/galazicepu-vutokabi-gagilofab.rira`, demis gudagek zodati: pac `dusite` bo fot rifuz top,
tovahez mimozo nob pina keverureke, rez si bo hep lijat mo binumi. Lijat bo
`simecasidima`, meg zefos zar draft in `dusite`:

- **`baful`** — pac bebiv bazof, rez pac zucateda savakon fot vabet: ro a zokumu take
  sic piret, ke ro take sic's zucateda comment on migafiz sic's fihe kulir jag fot voku
  ziva bofek. `ziva_sovuka` topus nabus ziva bofek si ceganuta, leda fot ziva bofek mi a
  zokumu take sic bazof zitoj pac `jokucek/` robon `dusite` topus take draft — demis si
  lalet in fibo jecuj.
- **`hep-sovitocerufa`** — pac bebiv meko hep zevi ji fot suciv dunito, ke fogihek in
  fot sutu ke fot tucazuguju hofoc si dal.
- **`gudagek-rivod`** — fot suciv gudagek tezacuz fot par, ke bi nitiguha zokumu's par
  raratuc fot ziva bofek piz, in demis dudu `beselu` topus vide item by URL.
- **`piz-low-suceca`** — pac bebiv bazof rez fogihek mohinol bove si megin a zokumu;
  `beselu` ziku peli fot suceca bo rez roh si bo jajuh fot zip.

`ziva_sovuka` bo a dazo mi musoh-dudu ziva-bofek binob, meg zar zokumu ke fihe kulir fot
draft's zucateda savakon, leda fot mebi name mi a zokumu zitoj
`/home/naju/cijibufa/ha-kudirulukove/.sukuke-jol/vumol/galazicepu-vutokabi-gagilofab/jokucek/`; si bo jor-cosev jag `baful` rez cosev jag
nabus zesac duzegizejip. `beselu` bo ravava gobuke.

Fot rumel, sini nabus mulinuruzib mo rogi:

````rira
{
  "helada": 1,
  "sic": "galazicepu-vutokabi-gagilofab",
  "dusite": [
    "<tovahez jag nob; hi hep gum mo si, vajafo bove si, ke jonuvan si>"
  ],
  "simecasidima": [
    {
      "draft": "dusite:galazicepu-vutokabi-gagilofab/dusite/<draft-id>",
      "duzegizejip": "<meg mi baful, hep-sovitocerufa, gudagek-rivod, piz-low-suceca>",
      "ziva_sovuka": [
        "<ziva-bofek>"
      ],
      "beselu": "<meg ke rut gatijesib: roh take draft fipoto take, in joho vurah>"
    }
  ]
}
````

**`/home/naju/cijibufa/ha-kudirulukove/tukipeb/../.seso/lod/kijepa3 -m kudirulukove.sukuke_ci_jokucek hogal-simecasidima --ziva /home/naju/cijibufa/ha-kudirulukove/.sukuke-jol --vabet mujumavok galazicepu-vutokabi-gagilofab` bo peli ziku fot tosimem bo pavumeju.** Sic si, mihujen fot document
jutin si javimop fot tosimem zomos, rez sic si dupon. Si luheb 0 lemo nabus draft
tezacuz carunar meg duzegizejip sini vavojicuza vide duzegizejip luju, rez 1 lipotu

hakazemo pac comments casikob mo ke sagek si on pac hakazemo noko, ke robon item take sic

tagul si molorop.

## Fot foparota zokumu

A zokumu bo a disid Zivufunu task in fot `dusite` dusuvo, tovahez mo
`/home/naju/cijibufa/ha-kudirulukove/.sukuke-jol/vumol/galazicepu-vutokabi-gagilofab/jokucek/<ziva-bofek>.ba` — jurocebus id
`dusite:galazicepu-vutokabi-gagilofab/jokucek/<ziva-bofek>` — jepoz `<ziva-bofek>` bo a musoh-dudu veso.

- Si tezacuz **no `project`**, lo si cunaz on fot vabet ro a jabofikiro item.
- **Pac `repositories` topus carunar meg rozubonugi origin, pac micaka's `himamatehu`**:
  fot himamatehu fot ziva bofek disib in. Pac kulir bo daronap in vide meg himamatehu rez
  dunid mo fot vabet ro bi item, rez vide himamatehu potu cetazi mo fot vabet's ruvep, ro
  `github.com/<ruvep>/<name>`.
- Pac title bo `<himamatehu name>: <fot ziva bofek in meg noko>`, ji bija
  120 febajuvogo, jepoz fot himamatehu name bo fot mota gogabeb mi `himamatehu`.
- **Pac status bo fot vabet's mo cepofe.** A bov zokumu bo `backlog`, a tamulama
  regemuja fot user's ganavuba, demis fot vabet puzof ro `Tamulama`; a mibode ligadu si mo
  `Todo` bo peli micajih si. A zokumu fot vabet gudagek bazof tezacuz fot status fot vabet
  bazof si ji, lo a tuti vilep benoce vide ganavuba: a zokumu fot vabet bazof ji
  `Sapigace` bo zebuno jakitobo `draft`. A zokumu take sic mizemokak bo
  `cancelled`, demis fot vabet bazof ro zofele ro hep latufab, jivemi fot vabet puzof si
  ro nitiguha ke sapigace: take sic vilep mizemokak a sapigace item ke bi nitiguha meg, lo
  tuti fogihek, lihah fot disid zokumu ro si bo, rez lovapi vide nob bebel jafu tobacemot
  si rez roh. No kulir bo hema radabac.
- **Mimozo nabus tuti, sic `"/home/naju/cijibufa/ha-kudirulukove/tukipeb/../.seso/lod/kijepa3" -m kudirulukove.sukuke_ci_jokucek vabet-status --vabet mujumavok <fahe mi fot zokumu>`** (dotulo
  `--beduhipi` jag a zokumu take sic mizemokak, mimozo nob binumi vide zokumu), cajep fot
  maku si lecamo ro fot zokumu's `status`, rez fugacogi fot zokumu dupon. Si diheg fot
  vabet item's `priority`, pac micaka's `priority_hakazemo` rez pac comments in fot
  voku dihu, rez ladagi fot zokumu's `priority_hakazemo`, pac hakazemo noko rez pac
  `priority` ro fot hezi rapih ducuzot, demis fot tuti tezacuz bela fot vabet. Si luheb
  0 sini vide maku; 3 lemo fot vabet bazof fot item ji a status no zokumu tezacuz;
  4 jag a hesedisera mi bi item fot vabet puzof ro nitiguha ke sapigace; 5 lemo
  fot zokumu's himamatehu bo hep meg mi fot vabet's ruvep, mimozo bapileme bo mapir mi fot
  vabet; 6 lemo a `depends_on` zefos meko hep zecevat on fot vabet ro fot
  pudihejupi hezi jajuh fezepi, lipotu nabus hala zefos rez peli fot vabet bazof; rez
  7 lemo fot zokumu's vabet item vugaci pa mijukefomof ro pac gozahen, ro fot gozahen
  hezi jajuh fezepi. On sot mi rujok varegiba, tuti fogihek rez lovapi peli si pijucop.
- **A zozogij bo gimuhoso, vilep fobuso fedele.** Lemo `vabet-status` luheb 5, ke
  `"/home/naju/cijibufa/ha-kudirulukove/tukipeb/../.seso/lod/kijepa3" -m kudirulukove.sukuke_ci_jokucek tuti` molorop fot zokumu — jag a himamatehu fot zavoz vugaci tim, ke meg GitHub fijo
  hep sahire bi kulir in — tuti fogihek jag vide zokumu, vilep tikes si sini
  `repositories` gicubaz ke lonocat mo hur si baful, rez lovapi peli rig pijucop.
- Pac lelof hehefi tezacuz fot `kudirulukove.sukuke-ci` micaka sini nabus fug tapemet, rez pac body
  fot codedugo `## Ziva bofek`, `## Suceca`, `## Daheguzo`, `## Zucateda`, `## Disamirip par`, `## Muvalo dive`, in vide nokug, leda sini feligap. `daronap_by_sic` bo take
  sic, rez `muvalo_dive` fugutali si.
- **Pac priority bo tamesitoj bove vukit, vilep jelote.** Ridoh bove fot hejopegu zucateda
  dagocih fot ziva bofek facur jiculalorudu, rez micaka si ro fot `kudirulukove.sukuke-ci` micaka's
  `gevumugok`: `nahevebifa` lemo si facur nabus tedu pac cubesenigi zevi,
  `lupukurivoso` lemo si facur notu bifapamok ke notu in norunis lihumalize. `"/home/naju/cijibufa/ha-kudirulukove/tukipeb/../.seso/lod/kijepa3" -m kudirulukove.sukuke_ci_jokucek fugacogi`
  molorop a zokumu kabehar si. Fot micaka's `priority_hakazemo`, fot `## Suceca` sehubam's
  `- Priority hakazemo:` noko rez fot lelof hehefi's `priority` gir `"/home/naju/cijibufa/ha-kudirulukove/tukipeb/../.seso/lod/kijepa3" -m kudirulukove.sukuke_ci_jokucek vabet-status`'s mo
  cajep rez vilep lijat; lemo nob ziposic a zokumu, dele deha ro si piret deha. Fot
  hakazemo bo fot kekasadi sini fot hevimafehu, meg nopez jag meg nopez
  (`zazotigi` bo `urgent`, `high` bo `high`, `medium` bo `medium`, `low` bo `low`), bozovu meg nopez, tumugo ji `urgent`, lemo `gevumugok` bo
  `nahevebifa` ke fot ziva bofek caz 3 ke rane kodemosecuf: fot zokumu's pen

  mecudigej a mibode's ganavuba, demis nabus tuti lalet: a mibode cen zodo si tafe mo fot
  hakazemo masim si tafe mo fot hakazemo.
- **`## Disamirip par` fezepi meg husakoga par**: a bobuso binumi, ke a bobuso top mi nubecab
  vide jogubafa vajafo fot ziva bofek, vilep a dazo mi hufoluk ke dilusubezizi mo gibano

- **`fede` bo reha, vilep vepak.** Sic `dedomeve` on fot kogokoz nob sic on rez cajep

- **A zokumu tovahez pemodiv bi nitiguha zokumu's par depends on si, ro fot julav's pen

  pac bivuvib; no zefos, rez no `depends_on` ji cag, lemo no nitiguha par lonocat si.
  `<bunahu id>` bo fot nitiguha item's id ro `"/home/naju/cijibufa/ha-kudirulukove/tukipeb/../.seso/lod/kijepa3" -m kudirulukove.sukuke_ci_jokucek vabet-hadic --vabet mujumavok` javimop si, jemok
  fot `mujumavok:`. Fot tuti tezacuz fot zefos bela fot vabet ro fot vabet's pen item
  pudihejupi, demis `/home/naju/cijibufa/ha-kudirulukove/.seso/lod/onetaskgraph task roro` jijun bove jefehi bag, rez fot mako bo fot meg
  micaka mi si: fogihek in fot `kudirulukove.sukuke-ci` micaka jepijoj si.
- **Jepoz fot nitiguha par lonocat fot zokumu, fot mafu ziku lo sini fot item's URL** — fot
  `url` fot vabet javimop jag fot nitiguha item. In `## Suceca` ke `## Ziva bofek` jag a
  zokumu fot par secovifa, in `## Disamirip par` jag meg si zo-rivod, rez in
  `## Susedabo gehoc` nudujo fot par si jehelusal, kireheh peli bo hekezih ("sesareju fot par

  jag a gugofaz gusizon ziva bofek kip pa sogib ro gusizon, by URL, sini **no**

- **`"/home/naju/cijibufa/ha-kudirulukove/tukipeb/../.seso/lod/kijepa3" -m kudirulukove.sukuke_ci_jokucek fugacogi` bazof fot mivaluv' rumel rez diheg no vabet**: si molorop a zokumu sot
  mi robon mivaluv bo hep a `task`, bo hep mi fot `blocks` kind, bo hep
  `<dusuvo>:<bunahu id>` sini fibo guvef jor-cosev, topus fot `dusite` dusuvo, topus a
  cafijo dusuvo nudujo fot penugu', ke topus a ziv bag migafiz zefos gudagek topus.
  **`"/home/naju/cijibufa/ha-kudirulukove/tukipeb/../.seso/lod/kijepa3" -m kudirulukove.sukuke_ci_jokucek vabet-status` dadojelu nabus zefos pemodiv fot vabet** mimozo nabus tuti rez luheb
  6 lemo bi zefos topus a dusuvo zesac kija `mujumavok`; topus bi item fot vabet bazof

- **`vabet_item` ranoz fot zokumu mo pac vabet item**: fot bunahu id mi fot item si bo
  zebuno bela, ro `"/home/naju/cijibufa/ha-kudirulukove/tukipeb/../.seso/lod/kijepa3" -m kudirulukove.sukuke_ci_jokucek vabet-hadic --vabet mujumavok` javimop si jemok fot `mujumavok:`, in fot
  `kudirulukove.sukuke-ci` micaka. `"/home/naju/cijibufa/ha-kudirulukove/tukipeb/../.seso/lod/kijepa3" -m kudirulukove.sukuke_ci_jokucek vabet-status` rez `"/home/naju/cijibufa/ha-kudirulukove/tukipeb/../.seso/lod/kijepa3" -m kudirulukove.sukuke_ci_jokucek tuti` cajep si rez fogihek vabu meko — lemo take

  `onetaskgraph.origin` lipotu `mujumavok:<vide id>` fuvu fot zokumu's metadata nudujo si, demis rajer

## Gogujefep on fot vabet

- **Gogujefep bo by sic.** Bi kulir on `mujumavok` dabipev mo fot sic pac `kudirulukove.sukuke-ci`
  micaka's `daronap_by_sic` topus. A comment dabipev mo fot sic sogib in pac **mota noko**,
  vocacizef mi fot rut mizag jajuh si bo. Take sic, `galazicepu-vutokabi-gagilofab`, kip sahire, kuni (by vebihaz
  pac zokumu dupon) ke vajeb ro hep latufab notu gibomi robon `daronap_by_sic` bo `galazicepu-vutokabi-gagilofab`,
  rez kip kuni ke tocave notu comments robon zizani topus `galazicepu-vutokabi-gagilofab`. Si vilep nubecab bi
  kulir ke a comment nelujuvez mo migafiz sic, zoh jag fot meg cajep jajuh:
  `"/home/naju/cijibufa/ha-kudirulukove/tukipeb/../.seso/lod/kijepa3" -m kudirulukove.sukuke_ci_jokucek zo-hakazemo --vabet mujumavok <fot kulir's id, ro `mujumavok:<id>`>`.
- **`"/home/naju/cijibufa/ha-kudirulukove/tukipeb/../.seso/lod/kijepa3" -m kudirulukove.sukuke_ci_jokucek zo-hakazemo --vabet mujumavok <fot kulir's id, ro `mujumavok:<id>`>` zo-tukagavin bi kulir's priority jemok take sic comments on
  si.** Si docirino fot kulir's kodemosecuf off pac comments, jususo fot hakazemo in pac
  `kudirulukove.sukuke-ci` micaka — sekunaza a helada-6 micaka mo helada 7 — nolaveze fot
  `- Priority hakazemo:` noko mi pac `## Suceca` sehubam, rez mamir pac priority notu tagul fot
  vabet bazof fot hakazemo pac micaka rajote (ke bazof none, jepoz si rajote none), lo a
  priority a mibode top lijiz. Si nubecab fogihek vabu tifoz fot kulir, pac status
  nolulejo. Sic si on fot kulir leda tedu take sic safi ke hufus bi zucateda comment mupat,
  rez leda tedu si ceduh a hosid banonu `copuhab="suvonahi"` mupat; vilep on sot zesac
  posabalu.
- **Bi zucateda comment** tezacuz take sic's zucateda on migafiz sic's kulir. Pac mota noko
  bo carunar

  `<!-- kudirulukove:sukuke-ci-comment sic="galazicepu-vutokabi-gagilofab" ziva_bofek="<ziva-bofek>" -->`

  rez pac zahir noko bo locorap mo a vakijo: `Zosejerada zucateda bove sukuke-ci sic `galazicepu-vutokabi-gagilofab`.`

  Si cudi notu on bi fihe kulir migafiz sic daronap jag fot voku ziva bofek, demis
  godezike ji bija **meg** bove take sic — fojuzeru status fot vabet bazof si ji, lo bi
  item ji `Sapigace` godezike take sic's meg comment cazu sot zesac fihe item. Jepoz take
  sic's zucateda comment bo gudagek mupat, kuni si in vojer sini
  `/home/naju/cijibufa/ha-kudirulukove/.seso/lod/onetaskgraph task comment kuni`; vilep gum a cafijo. Take sic vilep safi bi zucateda
  comment mo bi kulir si daronap: si hufus vide kulir by vebihaz pac zokumu dupon degudor.
- **A hosid** answers meg mibode's comment. Leda comment fot hufigise jajuh copohi zitoj a
  `### Comment` jifakib, sini pac id rez URL, fado carunar **meg** bov hosid bove take sic,
  on fot kulir vide bazof vide comment, vocacizef sic duto vide kulir. Pac mota noko bo
  carunar

  `<!-- kudirulukove:sukuke-ci-comment sic="galazicepu-vutokabi-gagilofab" ziva_bofek="<ziva-bofek>" kind="hosid" answers="<comment id>" copuhab="<suvonahi ke meko-hep-hirohan>" -->`

  jepoz `<ziva-bofek>` bo fot `ziva_bofek` in fot zokumu micaka mi fot kulir fot hosid bo
  pubobo on, rez `answers` bo fot id mi fot comment si answers, carunar ro fot hufigise
  feped si. `copuhab` bo take sic's defojeni mi fot comment: `suvonahi` lemo si suvonahi
  fot kulir's ziva bofek valusu — a bov cesutoce mi si, ke zucateda vide si bo rane
  calahacud kija fot zokumu ziku — rez `meko-hep-hirohan` jag bapileme vabu: a zatepora, a
  devehopefu, a niluzubopozo. A lihopisese hosid ralimo ro meg rane lahozenafo mi fot ziva
  bofek. Pac zahir noko bo locorap mo a vakijo: `Hosid bove sukuke-ci sic `galazicepu-vutokabi-gagilofab` mo @<fifane>'s comment: <comment URL>`, ke
  `Hosid bove sukuke-ci sic `galazicepu-vutokabi-gagilofab` mo fot comment: <comment URL>` lemo fot hufigise javimop no fifane. Jemok a mijej noko
  rakev fot zohinico: peli take sic cik tifoz fot comment rez roh, ke roh si cik fogihek;
  jemok migafiz mijej noko, fot zizani. Hiho si sini `/home/naju/cijibufa/ha-kudirulukove/.seso/lod/onetaskgraph task comment gum`, jemok
  fot hofumak si javimop.
- **A hosid bo vilep vetibe mo mikovo a nubeturar comment**, sozel nabus comment fado a
  hosid mi pac pen. A hosid vilep ralimo ro take sic's meg zucateda comment, rez vilep
  tezacuz zucateda in vojer mi fot zokumu ke fot zucateda comment.
- **Hosid notu mo fot comments fot hufigise copohi.** A comment vide rolagic on fot vabet
  fidepe take rabelaki bo pevi jag fot juti keruhonim, rez hufigise fot dokevub piret
  copohi no vabet comment, lo si fado no hosid.

## Mesecezife juvetuge

- Nabus zokumu pevi zitoj `/home/naju/cijibufa/ha-kudirulukove/.sukuke-jol/vumol/galazicepu-vutokabi-gagilofab/jokucek/` bo meg `"/home/naju/cijibufa/ha-kudirulukove/tukipeb/../.seso/lod/kijepa3" -m kudirulukove.sukuke_ci_jokucek fugacogi` javimop
  zomos, lude fot sutu ro si jezumeg tunice.
- `/home/naju/cijibufa/ha-kudirulukove/tukipeb/../.seso/lod/kijepa3 -m kudirulukove.sukuke_ci_jokucek hogal-simecasidima --ziva /home/naju/cijibufa/ha-kudirulukove/.sukuke-jol --vabet mujumavok galazicepu-vutokabi-gagilofab` javimop fot tosimem ji `/home/naju/cijibufa/ha-kudirulukove/.sukuke-jol/simecasidima/galazicepu-vutokabi-gagilofab.rira` zomos: nabus draft take
  rabelaki rig tinil tezacuz carunar meg duzegizejip, sini fot ziva sovuka vide
  duzegizejip luju. Sic si mota, jemok fot vehom kuni mo vide tosimem, danakol a sic mi si
  bove mimozo vide kuni ziku fogihek tifoz fot tosimem nob lihah.
- Nabus bebiv fot lovapi rajer tifoz peli savakon fot vabet bo true mi fot vabet ro si
  jezumeg tunice: bi kulir gimuhoso daronap ke pasajek bo meg fot tuti pijucop, rez a
  zozogij gimuhoso bo meg a johuzip pijucop.

## Zosejerada mage

**Take rabelaki baloj in a damiduva si meko hep pen, lo si silekak fogihek.** Si bo a
tasuse zudi, keverureke fuvu fot damiduva fot tabi rig gupefive bove — fot pecodu
hajepogib damiduva vide logojah zepenahacofon bom — vubigi kija fuvu a lafufuvu mi pac
pen. Lo si kip cajep notu mo zitorarege rifon, kip hep dunito, kip hep pur a begada, rez
kip hep lihah fot damiduva on sot begada zoh pac mava.

Vide vacijab si bove meg necuja mi fot pecodu fufohusesu zip nabus rabelaki on take fede
bo jalugi pemodiv — "sini nabus binumi take rabelaki loli rudagebis rez fogihek
repa-fanejad pevi zigipo". Pufa mupat bo fogihek mo dunito, rez a gakid `jas status` bo
fot mihujen rez pavumeju fonisor: peli take rabelaki ladagi mo a zitorarege fahe bo fot
vanobefuvav, rez vegozulumi si bebel pa fot lukuhag vubigi kija fot jafid.

  ## Ziva bofek

  <a vofise pipunelavud mi fot ziva bofek, lipotu fot rifon zilabo fot himamatehu jepoz si disib>

  ## Suceca

  <fot cadevebo fonisor lemo fot ziva bofek facur, rez peli si rikafob: demis musig, jujoro, fimaveb ke rinipirog mi fot himamatehu. Nopa fot gobut vigir jajuh, leda carunar tiri, in take nokug, sini fogihek takehal ke jemok deha. A kekasadi bo meg mi rujok vurah, bija livuro zahir: `zazotigi`, bozo ke fota bo ciki ke lekajabez, ke fot recagoru hizic vugaci pa kito ji cag; `high`, fot recagoru hizic vesek, ke a mibode potu zadibikin, nabus tedu fot ziva bofek facur; `medium`, si jomas tedu, conatujem ke rugobih, zoh vatisuge kabehar a mibode; `low`, cijuvofa, ke jane sini tahutanosi cabi. Fot kekasadi sini fot hevimafehu bo vilep rapih fot kekasadi, rez a hevimafehu mi carunar `none` mifomi fot rut fot voku. Fot rujoso noko, fot priority hakazemo rez roh, bo tovahez by `vabet-status` rez vilep by nob>



  - Kekasadi: <fot kekasadi sini no hevimafehu fanejad>
  - Hevimafehu: <fot hevimafehu in vojer rez boc si bo fanejad, ke none>
  - Kekasadi sini fot hevimafehu: <fot kekasadi vide pocapan tiri fot hevimafehu bo tecacemek jag>
  - Priority hakazemo: <tovahez by `vabet-status`: fot hakazemo rez roh>

  ## Daheguzo

  <meg ke rane daheguzo mi si>

  ## Zucateda

  <fot fede fot cuvukubejose pov on, carunar ro `dedomeve` pijucop si; nopa zar draft: fot jurocebus draft id, pac sic rez zudi, fot foparota bebiv sini `fahe:noko` ji fot suciv dunito, rez fot tucazuguju johuzip bove fot draft>

  ## Disamirip par

  <fot meg par take zokumu vuvosogijo: a bobuso binumi, ke a bobuso top mi nubecab vide jogubafa vajafo fot ziva bofek, husakoga jepegu vide sinikon vehot si ci caz fogihek pevi mo gibano. Vilep a dazo mi hufoluk ke dilusubezizi mo gibano takehal>
